title: ai-agent-rules deployment diagram
description: How ai-agent-rules runs: one binary installed beside zazzle on the developer's machine, started by a coding agent or a developer through `zazzle agent get-rules`, `zazzle ai-agent-rules check` or `zazzle ai-agent-rules explain`; it reads rule and skill files and exits. Nothing stays resident.

nodes.name: Coding agent's shell
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle agent get-rules PATH` before working in a folder, and `zazzle ai-agent-rules check` after editing rule or skill files, as agents/skills/zazzle-agent/SKILL.md says.

nodes.name: The developer's machine
nodes.description: A Mac (the release ships universal macOS binaries) or, from a local build, another Unix.

nodes.name: zazzle invoker
nodes.description: Replaces itself with the ai-agent-rules found in its own directory for `zazzle ai-agent-rules ARGS`.

nodes.name: ai-agent-rules
nodes.description: Reads rule and skill files from the file system and prints them or just their names, the problems check finds in them (exit 1 when there are any), or why each one applies.

artifacts.name: ai-agent-rules
artifacts.description: Built with cargo build --release -p ai-agent-rules, or installed beside zazzle from the universal macOS release tarball or the zazzle Homebrew formula.

relationships.description: Runs as the calling user, in the caller's working directory.
`zazzle agent get-rules PATH`, `zazzle ai-agent-rules check [PATH]`, `zazzle ai-agent-rules explain PATH`.
exec with the arguments after `agent`, keeping the caller's streams and exit status.
